subject.title: feat(ui): modernize the Control UI dashboard

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this dashboard-wide Nova/flat-navigation visual baseline for all Control UI users after the active-route visibility repair?
rationale: The remaining decision is not only mechanical: the PR deliberately changes shared default presentation and navigation behavior across every existing theme.

options.title: Sponsor the refresh after repair
options.body: Accept the dashboard-wide visual direction, require the active Settings route to be revealed, and land after focused regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only clearly desired additive pieces, such as the optional Nova theme, and drop shared default restyling until a separate UX baseline is agreed.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Decline the new shared UI baseline and leave current dashboard presentation unchanged.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the refresh after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the dashboard-wide visual direction, require the active Settings route to be revealed, and land after focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI sidebar-navigation work is the closest available history signal for the affected navigation boundary.
